root_causes.label: Invalid credentials or stale cached password
root_causes.definition: The account or client is submitting a credential that is no longer valid.

root_causes.label: Account lockout
root_causes.definition: Repeated failed sign-ins have triggered account lockout.

root_causes.label: MFA registration missing
root_causes.definition: The required multi-factor authentication method is not registered.

root_causes.label: OAuth consent not granted
root_causes.definition: An application lacks approved consent for the permissions it requests.

root_causes.label: Device compliance requirement failed
root_causes.definition: A Conditional Access policy blocks access because one or more devices are noncompliant.

root_causes.label: Conditional Access policy scope mismatch
root_causes.definition: A policy assignment or exclusion does not match the intended user or group scope.

root_causes.label: Endpoint disk space exhausted
root_causes.definition: Insufficient free disk space prevents an application or operating-system operation.

root_causes.label: Print queue stalled
root_causes.definition: A stuck spooler job or queue prevents printing.

root_causes.label: Stale compliance state
root_causes.definition: The management service has not received a recent device compliance check-in.

root_causes.label: Enrollment profile mismatch
root_causes.definition: The device was enrolled with a profile that does not match the intended deployment.

root_causes.label: Mailbox quota exceeded
root_causes.definition: Mailbox storage has reached its configured quota.

root_causes.label: Corrupt Outlook profile
root_causes.definition: A local Outlook profile or cache is damaged and prevents normal startup or synchronization.

root_causes.label: SharePoint permission missing
root_causes.definition: The user does not have the required permission on the target site or library.

root_causes.label: SharePoint storage limit reached
root_causes.definition: The site or tenant storage limit prevents new content from being uploaded.

root_causes.label: Teams audio device unavailable
root_causes.definition: The selected microphone or speaker is unavailable to the application.

root_causes.label: Guest identity mismatch
root_causes.definition: The guest is signing in with an identity different from the invited identity.

root_causes.label: Invalid proxy configuration
root_causes.definition: A proxy setting or authentication issue blocks access to required services.

root_causes.label: DNS resolution failure
root_causes.definition: The endpoint cannot resolve a service hostname through its configured DNS path.

root_causes.label: Suspicious sign-in
root_causes.definition: Sign-in telemetry indicates a risky or anomalous sign-in requiring security review.

root_causes.label: Legacy authentication blocked
root_causes.definition: A client uses a legacy authentication protocol that is blocked by policy.

severity_policy.P1: Confirmed critical service or security impact across multiple departments/sites; immediate major-incident/security escalation.
severity_policy.P2: Multiple users or a business-critical workflow materially impaired; prompt service-owner coordination.
severity_policy.P3: One user or a limited endpoint scope; standard support handling and workaround may exist.
severity_policy.P4: Informational, cosmetic, or low-impact request; no material service interruption.
